create_chat: create a new chat session with title, model, and metadata via POST /chats/new endpoint
get_chat_list: get paginated list of user chat titles with pinned and folder filtering via GET /chats/list
export_chat_stats: export chat usage stats as JSON or stream as NDJSON with per-chat message counts and model usage
delete_chat_by_id: delete a specific chat by ID with automatic orphan tag cleanup via DELETE /chats/{id}
clone_chat: clone an existing chat with optional new title and branch point tracking via POST /chats/{id}/clone
